title: Uzbekistan cement production reaches 12.1Mt
body_markdown: **Uzbekistan:** Cement plants in Uzbekistan produced 12.1Mt of cement in the first seven months of the year, according to the National Statistics Committee. This represents an increase of 0.1Mt or 0.8% year-on-year from the same period of 2025, when cement production totalled 12Mt. From January to July 2024, cement production reached 9.1Mt.
